target: Decide the two-qutrit dual-unitary entangling-power optimum conjecture15/16 outside the2-unitary component.

primary_attestation.source: Rajchel-Mieldzioć etal. arXiv:2508.04777v3, p9, parent-read lines568–572
primary_attestation.quote: The dual unitary U_s(2π/3) is an orthogonal matrix with entangling power 15/16 = 0.9375 which is likely to be the highest possible value for dual unitaries that are not 2-unitary.
primary_attestation.quote_convention: Line-break whitespace and mathematical typography normalised from the pinned PDF text; the numerical and substantive wording is unchanged.

definitions: D={U∈U9:U^R unitary}, T={U∈U9:U^Γ unitary}, O9=LU·P9=all2-unitaries (imported uniqueness). e_p(U)=[E(U)+E(US)-E(S)]/E(S), E(U)=1−tr[(U^R U^R†)^2]/81, E(S)=8/9. Re-read exact source conventions.
baseline: Our completed T7 proof gives compactness of D\O9, a qualitative e_p gap, and Frobenius separation>=1, but NOT an explicit entangling-power gap. The published numerical best is15/16.

acceptance.proof: For every dual U outside O9, e_p(U)<=15/16, plus an exactly verified attaining gate from the cited U_s family (or another). T-dual corollary via U→US must be justified.
acceptance.counterexample: Exact algebraic/rigorously validated dual gate, provably not2-unitary, with certified e_p>15/16. Floating projections or an ansatz-only inequality are insufficient.
acceptance.intermediate: A rigorous nonsharp explicit e_p gap or exact full-component reduction is reportable with its actual scope, not a solution of the sharp conjecture.

representation: Start from [44]2212.06737v2 general two-qutrit-dual normal form (product state mapped to product state) and refs1912.12021/2101.04580, PRXQuantum3:040331. Separate2-unitary component before optimising: a polynomial inequality over allD is false since e_p=1 onO9. The Frobenius radius alone does not imply an e_p bound without an additional error-bound argument. Freeze any ansatz/reduction before computing.
controls: Exactly verify O9 at e_p1, SWAP at0, and the15/16 witness; mutate a gate tobreak duality or the objective normalisation.
